argv: [Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new(); $cpu=Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object Name,NumberOfCores,NumberOfLogicalProcessors,Manufacturer; $os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption,Version,OSArchitecture; @{processor=$cpu;operating_system=$os} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4

scope: actual local host only; no remote CPU, deployment, hardware-interrupt or side-channel execution
dependencies: scientific programs use CPython standard library; TeX/Poppler/ReportLab are typesetting only
